left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Electively scheduled for surgical operation that require general anesthesia  [AND] and expected duration of hospitalization of longer than one day (for patients in Perioperative Evaluation & Management [POEM] [OR] ) or high clinical suspicion of sepsis by the emergency physician (for patients in emergency center)
  -  Ability to give informed consent
If the patient is incapacitated and unable to give informed consent, the next-of-kin or a person who has the power of attorney must be present for informed consent

right.raw_text:
-  For patients in the emergency center only, two or more of the following SIRS criteria:
       -  Leukocytes > 12,000/mm^3  [OR] or < 4,000/mm^3  [OR] or > 10% immature (band) forms, provided that no filgrastim  [OR] or pegfilgrastim  [AND] was administered within 30 days and no leukemia
       -  Heart rate > 90 beats/minute (min)
       -  Respiratory rate > 20 breaths/min or partial pressure of carbon dioxide (CO2) < 32 mmHg
       -  Oral temperature  [OR] > 38 degrees Celsius (C)  [OR] or < 36 degrees C or axillary temperature > 37 degrees C  [OR] or < 35 degrees C
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Inability to give informed consent or a person who has power of attorney for medical decision is not available
  -  Being moribund (for patients in emergency center) or cancellation of surgery (for patients in POEM)
  -  Active "Do Not Resuscitate" [OR]  or "Do Not Intubate" order
